svg.title: Public path
svg.desc: Understand, explore, then verify. Eight governed domains lead to existing evidence, analysis, methods and sources. Search discovers existing pages and records, including dated chronology events; it does not validate claims.
svg.text: Also governed: Evidence Readings · Methodology · Measurement priorities · Search · Compare · About · Corrections · Rights.

g.data-search-types: page question evidence reading measurement source source_locator chronology
g.text: Search discovers pages · questions · Evidence Records · Readings · measurement priorities · source records
and source locators · dated chronology events, deep-linked to their Finance anchors.
Search supports discovery; it does not validate a claim.

svg.text: Compare tests comparability before showing values; it does not create a finding.
Missing is not zero. Disagreement is not automatically an error.
